exercise.name: Decline EZ Bar Skull Crusher
library_steps: Lie on a decline bench with your feet hooked, EZ bar above your chest.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar towards your forehead.
Straighten your arms again, keeping your upper arms still.
exercise.one_line_summary: Lying on a decline bench with the feet hooked, an EZ bar held overhand on the inner bends straight above the chest; the elbows bend ~105 deg and the bar lowers toward the forehead while the upper arms stay still. Triceps does the work.

setup.target: Decline bench (~20 deg), legs hooked under the rollers.

setup.why: Library step 1; EZ bar as in MARC.

muscles.emg: Elbow extensor; overhead elbow extension grew the long head 1.5x more than at the side (MAEO).

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: Elbows drift toward the head or the feet.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Turns it into a pullover or a press.

sources.citation: Maeo S, Wu Y, Huang M, et al. 2023. Triceps brachii hypertrophy is substantially greater after elbow extension training performed in the overhead versus neutral arm position. Eur J Sport Sci.
sources.what_it_gave: 12 weeks of elbow extensions (90-0 deg) overhead vs arm at the side: overhead grew the long head 1.5x more (+28.5 % vs +19.6 %) and the whole triceps 1.4x more.

sources.citation: Tiwana MS, Sinkler MA, Bordoni B. 2023. Anatomy, Shoulder and Upper Limb, Triceps Muscle. StatPearls (NCBI Bookshelf).
sources.what_it_gave: Triceps brachii: three heads on the back of the upper arm, extends the elbow; the long head starts on the shoulder blade.

sources.citation: Marcolin G, Panizzolo FA, Petrone N, et al. 2018. Differences in electromyographic activity of biceps brachii and brachioradialis while performing three variants of curl. PeerJ 6:e5165.
sources.what_it_gave: Dumbbell, straight-bar and EZ-bar curls at 65 % 1RM: the EZ bar gave higher biceps and brachioradialis EMG than the dumbbell curl; straight vs EZ bar differed little.
